copy.headline: Texas Sports Academy, tied to AI-driven Alpha School, is Texas’ biggest voucher recipient so far
copy.caption: Students at Texas Sports Academy, which schedules two hours of academics a day, have received $6.5 million in voucher payouts, more than twice the next-largest recipient, according to data from the state comptroller.
